annotations.title: Submit a deliverable or proof to an escrow

description: Submit a deliverable or proof to an escrow. Payee only, before release_deadline, at most 10 times. The escrow's checks run on output; with auto_release a pass releases the escrow in the same call. Needs can_submit_deliverables. Answers 501 feature_unavailable while stand-alone escrow is switched off (ESCROW_API_ENABLED).

output.description: The deliverable or proof (any JSON, at most 512 KiB).
